entries.topic: Gaza ledger: toll, displacement and destruction as of autumn 2026

claims.text: OCHA snapshot of 30 Sep 2026, citing the Gaza Ministry of Health: 74,032 Palestinians killed and 175,142 injured since 7 October 2023.
Of 71,444 dead identified by the Gaza MoH by 31 Dec 2025: 34,078 men, 21,283 children, 10,983 women and 5,100 elderly (OCHA snapshot, 30 Sep 2026).

OCHA snapshot: Israeli fatalities 'over 1,200' including 7 October and its immediate aftermath and foreign nationals, per Israeli media citing official sources; citing the Israeli military's website, 474 soldiers killed in the Gaza ground operation (layout of the injured figure unclear).

OCHA snapshot: 597 aid workers killed (403 UN and UN-contracted personnel including 394 UNRWA staff, 135 NGO staff, 55 Palestine Red Crescent, 4 ICRC); more than 1,700 health workers killed (MoH, to 7 Oct 2025; may overlap); 145 civil defence staff killed on duty; 262 journalists and media workers killed to 30 Jun 2026 per the Palestinian Journalists Syndicate.

OCHA snapshot: 1.98 million people (94%) need shelter assistance and about 1.2 million (58%) face critical or catastrophic shelter conditions (assessment Aug 2026); 65% of assessed households live in tents or makeshift shelters; more than 950,000 people in 989 displacement sites at flood risk (Sep 2026).

OCHA snapshot: 371,888 of 485,361 housing units (76.6%) destroyed or damaged (RDNA, as of Oct 2025); 526 of 564 school buildings (~93%) need full reconstruction or major rehabilitation (Education Cluster, 11 Oct 2025); 88% of above-ground water and sanitation assets and 76% of underground networks damaged; 3% of cropland undamaged and accessible (FAO/UNOSAT, June 2026); all functioning health facilities only partially functional except 4 field hospitals, 22 primary care centres and 15 medical points.

OCHA snapshot: in a WASH Cluster check of 5–12 Aug 2026, 57% of assessed households were below the 6 litres per person per day drinking standard and 91% faced moderate to high water insecurity; more than 2,900 children aged 6–59 months admitted for malnutrition treatment in August 2026.

L'Orient Today, 12 Aug 2026: Gaza Health Ministry counted at least 73,388 killed and 174,259 wounded since October 2023, including at least 1,259 killed and 4,148 wounded since the October 2025 ceasefire; bodies continue to be recovered from rubble.

sources.label: UN OCHA, 'Gaza Reported Impact Snapshot', 30 September 2026

entries.topic: West Bank ledger: deaths, displacement and demolitions 2023-2026

claims.text: Oxfam analysis of UN data (11 Jun 2026): 1,244 Palestinians including 268 children killed by Israeli forces or settlers in the West Bank from the start of 2023 to the end of 2025, against 1,036 including 225 children from 2006 to end-2022; 43 Israeli settlers including 10 children killed by Palestinians in 2023–25 against 86 in 2006–22; nearly 46,000 Palestinians displaced in three years against just over 13,000 in the previous 14.

Oxfam: in the first three months of 2026, over 540 settler attacks, 33 Palestinians killed, over 2,200 displaced and more than 60 water and sanitation structures vandalised; Oxfam's Bushra Khalidi: 'The mounting killing of civilians in the West Bank is tragic and horrifying.'

OCHA West Bank snapshot (data to 31 Aug 2026), January 2025–August 2026: 322 Palestinians killed including 74 children (284 by Israeli forces, 25 by settlers, 13 by either); 20 Israelis killed in the West Bank including 8 members of Israeli forces; 3,459 settler attacks causing casualties or damage; 2,702 structures demolished (94% for lack of permits); 41,951 Palestinians displaced including about 15,882 children (UNRWA, Aug 2026), 34,176 of them from the Jenin and Tulkarm operations.

OCHA update #230 (17 Oct 2024), 7 Oct 2023–14 Oct 2024: 728 Palestinians killed in the West Bank including East Jerusalem (711 by Israeli forces, 12 by settlers, 7 unknown); 23 Israelis killed including 16 members of Israeli forces; about 1,492 settler attacks; 1,799 Palestinian structures destroyed, confiscated, sealed or forcibly demolished.

entries.topic: Lebanon ledger: destruction in 2026, northern Israel, status October 2026

claims.text: UNDP and Lebanon's CNRS rapid building-level assessment (released 22 Jun 2026), comparing imagery of late April 2026 with October 2025: 11,095 buildings completely destroyed affecting 17,891 housing units, 2,242 partially damaged and 9,311 with minor damage in south Lebanon; direct building damage estimated at $1.38bn; does not cover later weeks.

NPR 26 Jul 2026: in Yaroun, the mayor said 180 of about 200 houses had been destroyed by Israeli forces since March; after the 17 April truce Israel sent bulldozers to demolish more buildings, saying it targets Hezbollah infrastructure but rarely giving details; in March Katz said Israel intended to depopulate Lebanese villages near the border to create a 'buffer zone'; Israel prevents displaced residents from returning.

Times of Israel 17 Oct 2026: Lebanon's presidency said its military delegation would demand 'an end to Israeli attacks in Lebanon' at a trilateral meeting in Tampa on 20 Oct 2026; Israel has kept striking what it calls terror targets, saying they violate the agreement.

Al-Monitor/Reuters 7 Mar 2026: Hezbollah told residents of Kiryat Shmona: 'All residents of Kiryat Shmona are asked to evacuate immediately. Head south.' Katz urged northern residents to stay in their homes; tens of thousands had evacuated after October 2023 and returned after the November 2024 ceasefire.

claims.text: Haaretz reported (late January 2026) that the Israeli military had accepted the Gaza health ministry's estimate of about 71,000 killed and was analysing the data to separate combatants and civilians; on 30 January 2026 military spokesperson Nadav Shoshani said the reports did not reflect official data: 'Any publication or report on this matter will be released through official and orderly channels.'

Audit re-fetch, OCHA Gaza snapshot 30 Sep 2026: of 670 health facilities, 42 fully functioning, 273 partially functioning, 355 not functioning; Israeli soldiers since the ground operation (Israeli military website) 474 killed; journalists and media workers 262 killed to 30 June 2026 (PJS); aid workers 597.

Audit re-fetch, OCHA West Bank snapshot (to 31 Aug 2026): UNRWA counted 12,557 displaced from Jenin camp 'during operations by Israeli or Palestinian forces', and 12,412 from Tulkarm camp and 9,207 from Nur Shams attributed to Israeli forces' operations.
